description: Create a new e-invoice file from structured JSON. Builds XRechnung UBL/CII or a ZUGFeRD/Factur-X PDF, validates the result with the same rule sets, and returns the file only if it is valid. Creates new files only; it does not read or change existing files. Supports invoice, credit note, corrected, partial and final invoices, prepayments, and an optional EPC payment QR page for PDF output. B2B only. Requires the caller's own Electronic Invoice API key, sent either directly as Authorization: Bearer eia_live_... or through an OAuth 2.1 access token issued by this server. A call that reaches the API and returns 200, 400, 422 or 504 counts against the plan quota.

country.description: Rule set country for validation of the generated invoice. Default DE.

format.description: Output format. xrechnung-ubl and xrechnung-cii return XML. zugferd-en16931, zugferd-xrechnung and facturx-en16931 return a PDF/A-3 file. Required.

invoice.description: Invoice data per the Electronic Invoice API schema. Required fields: number, issueDate, seller, buyer, lines. Optional fields include typeCode, dueDate, deliveryDate, currency, buyerReference, notes, payment, documentAllowances, documentCharges, prepayments. Amounts are JSON numbers, dates are YYYY-MM-DD. See the API documentation for the full object.

lang.description: Language of the PDF visual. Default de.

qr.description: Add an EPC QR payment page to PDF output when IBAN and amount due are present. The response header X-Payment-QR says added or skipped with a reason. Ignored for XML output.

name: generate_invoice
title: Generate e-invoice
